_how_to_use: The words for the client PDF. Plain English, short, warm, in the adviser's voice. Every number must match the calculator output. NEVER put internal notes here (data doubts, template carry-overs, health, NRIC/policy numbers, 'Check before presenting' items).
client_name: Full name as the client likes it
title: Your Financial Health Check
adviser_note: Cover note from the adviser, 2-3 sentences, first name, warm and specific: what they've done well and what this review is about.
where_you_stand: 3-4 sentences. Their situation and the one big question for them now.
bad: 0-3 short bullets; leave empty if nothing is truly bad
adviser_take: Optional. the adviser's one-paragraph big-picture comment on the health-check page.
protection_note: 2-3 sentences: how covered they are in plain words, and when to review.
retirement_note: 2-3 sentences: want vs building, and the strongest lever. No guarantees.
timeline_note: 1-2 sentences for the life timeline page: how long their money lasts at their target, in plain words. No guarantees.
levers_note: Optional, 1-2 sentences above the levers page: what's in their control. Default text is used if empty.
plan_note: Optional, 1-2 sentences above the Your plan chart. Default text is used if empty.
legacy_note: Optional, only with --legacy: 2 sentences on who gets what today vs their wish.

actions.title: Short action (max 7 words)
actions.why: One line: the number or reason it fixes.
actions.how: One line: the kind of solution, no product names unless the adviser chose one.

next_steps: Documents or answers to bring to the next meeting
